config_name: Zenbook S 14 — Core Ultra 7 258V (Lunar Lake), 32GB, 1TB SSD, 14" 3K OLED 120Hz touch

battery.notes: 72Wh — Lunar Lake's standout efficiency; ~12-15h light use widely reported.

price.notes: BBY direct SKU 18389564, reg $2,449.95 sale $2,299.95 (2026-11-24). 4.51/5 across 406 BBY reviews — the most-reviewed Zenbook on CA retail. Previous-gen notable value.

reviews.quote: the Zenbook S14 OLED pairs an ultra-thin premium chassis with Lunar Lake efficiency and a beautiful 3K OLED display

praises: 406 Best Buy reviews at 4.51/5 — proven, popular platform
Lunar Lake 258V battery life is superb for x86 Windows
32GB on-package RAM at this price beats newer 16GB tiers
Arc 140V plays light games at 1080p better than most iGPUs of its day
Bright 3K 120Hz touch OLED still competitive in 2026
complaints: Older 2024 chassis — no Ceraluminum refresh, thicker bezels than 2026 models
Can run warm under sustained loads in the ultra-thin chassis
MyASUS software bloat complaints common in BBY reviews

design_philosophy: The Lunar Lake-era premium Zenbook S 14 that made ultra-thin x86 ultrabooks practical; still sold at Best Buy CA alongside the 2026 refresh. With 32GB/1TB and a 3K 120Hz OLED at $2,299, it remains the sane-spec value pick of the Zenbook premium family.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from Ultrabookreview Zenbook S14 OLED (UX3406) review + sibling deltas: 32GB keeps productivity high vs 16GB tiers; Arc 140V gaming 3.5 per dataset calibration (vs B390 ~5). UBR quote is from the S14 OLED review index (paraphrased descriptor), flagged for parent.
